thread:
maya (marketing): quick ask — can we assemble a 1-pager + benchmark narrative for enterprise prospects (CISO/platform) that covers: security controls, SLA tiers, and deploy-mode decision flow? need a concise asset for webinar followups and inbound routing. due EOD tomorrow.

oliver (product): copying the required sections: TL;DR, security checklist, SLA summary (latency & availability by tier), deployment decision flow (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), benchmark highlights + small graph. keep it < 400 words.

sam (design): I can mock a single-page layout. do we want a single column or split tech + biz? single column is easier for sales snippets. i'll draft mobile-friendly and A4 print.

nisha (sales): include a short field-facing opener: "Why infra matters: predictable inference cost & guaranteed latency for regulated apps." add two quick customer-facing Qs: 1) "Which deploy mode meets our compliance?" 2) "What SLA do we need for [X] concurrency?" Sales needs 3 CTAs: trial, demo, security audit.

alex (growth): suggested subject lines for webinar followups: "Secure, predictable LLM inference for regulated teams" / "Reducing inference cost while meeting SLA" — pick one. also add routing tags for inbound leads: security_interest, sla_enquiry, private_deploy.

oliver (product): benchmark numbers to surface (use anonymized results): Hosted API median p95 gen latency 120ms per 1k tokens; Dedicated reserved pool p95 80ms; Private (on-prem/GPU optimized) p95 60ms. Cost delta callout: typical per-token cost reduction 1.8x when moving from hosted to dedicated + batching. add note: "results depend on model, seq len, and batching)."

sam (design): draft copy for top hero (short): "Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM serving for security-first teams. SLA-backed latency tiers, private deployments, and cost controls that scale."

maya (marketing): good. can someone post a tiny routing snippet we can hand to inbound automation team? need simple rule for demo vs security triage.

oliver (product): routing example for the automation engine (one-liner):
```
if lead.tags contains "private_deploy" or lead.company.size > 1000: route -> enterprise-security-team
elif lead.tags contains "sla_enquiry": route -> solutions-sales
else: route -> trial-onboarding
```

nisha (sales): also add "require security questionnaire" flag for private_deploy route. we do a quick pre-call checklist.

launch-bot: reminder — webinar "Secure Inference: SLA & Deploy Modes" scheduled Thu 10am PT. Registrants: 184. Recording will be available on the assets page.

alex (growth): final asks for the one-pager: 1) hero + 3 bullets (security, SLA, deploy modes) 2) 2-line benchmark callout 3) routing snippet 4) 3 CTAs and a short webinar blurb. i'll wire it into lead nurture.

maya (marketing): perfect — sam pls attach draft PDF + copy by 5pm. oliver pls confirm benchmark phrasing is safe. nisha: i'll add the sales CTAs and security checklist. thanks! :thumbsup:
